title: Extract Xinference model resolver lifecycle boundary
description: Xinference STT and rerank adapters still duplicate model UID cache, list-running-models, optional launch, and not-running error policy. AstrBot repeats this in separate sources; Rust can improve it with a typed resolver shared by self-hosted model providers.

files.change: Expose a small resolver API for lazy model UID lookup and caching.
Centralize model UID cache, list models call, launch call, model type, and not-running policy.
Use the shared resolver while keeping multipart transcription concerns local.
Use the shared resolver while keeping rerank payload dispatch local.

criteria: Xinference model cache/list/launch logic is not duplicated between STT and rerank adapters.
Adapters pass model type and requested model into a resolver instead of owning lifecycle details.
Existing Xinference STT and rerank tests continue to cover running, launched, and disabled auto-launch paths.
convergence.verification_command: cargo test -p astrbot-provider --test xinference_stt --test xinference_rerank && cargo clippy -p astrbot-provider -- -D warnings
